column3: NKJV has “Woe to the inhabitants of the earth and the sea,” following the Textus Receptus; the critical text reads “Woe to the earth and the sea.”
NKJV has “the testimony of Jesus Christ,” following the Textus Receptus; the critical text reads “the testimony of Jesus.”
NKJV has no verse 12:18; its words appear at the start of NKJV 13:1 as “Then I stood,” following the Textus Receptus, where the critical text reads “he (the dragon) stood.”
